results.title: Perfecto Alternatives in 2026: 7 Tools Compared for Mobile and Web | Autosana
results.content:
## 1. Is BrowserStack a good Perfecto alternative?

BrowserStack is the most direct swap for the Mobile Device Cloud and the cross-browser grid, and the thing it fixes immediately is the buying motion. Pricing is published, a card gets you started, and the evaluation happens against your own app rather than against a slide deck.

It carries 3,500 real devices, runs Selenium, Appium, Playwright and Cypress through Automate and App Automate, and offers Live for interactive sessions. Our BrowserStack alternatives guide covers the comparison from the other direction.

Where it stops short of Perfecto is the enterprise wrapper. There is no desktop application testing and no standalone accessibility module, so a team using those parts of the suite keeps them or sources them separately. [...] | Tool | What It Tests | Pricing | Best For |
------|
| BrowserStack | Web and mobile, 3,500+ real devices | From $29/mo | Published pricing and the broadest CI integrations |
| LambdaTest | Web and mobile, 10,000+ devices | Free tier, paid from $15/mo | Largest device count plus codeless authoring |
| Autosana | iOS, Android and web | Per agent-run, self-serve trial | Teams replacing the authoring layer |
| Sauce Labs | Web and mobile, 10,000+ devices | Contact sales | One-vendor enterprise replacement |
| Kobiton | Mobile, 7,000+ devices | Contact sales | On-premises and BYOD device labs |
| Playwright | Web (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) | Free, Apache 2.0 | Web-only Perfecto usage |
| testRigor | Web and mobile | Published on request | Non-technical authors writing plain English | [...] Set against that, the mobile-first positioning means web automation is a secondary surface, so a team replacing both halves of Perfecto needs a second tool beside it.

Pros: on-premises and BYOD device labs, scriptless capture, device-level logs.

‍Cons: narrower web coverage than the general-purpose clouds, and contract pricing makes comparison hard.

‍Pricing: contact sales.

‍Best for: teams with data residency requirements.

## 6. Can Playwright replace Perfecto for web testing?

Where your Perfecto usage is browser testing, yes, and the subscription goes with it. Playwright drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit through one API with auto-waiting, network interception and native parallelism, across five languages, and it runs in any CI runner you already have.
